content_sections.text: Candidates planning to apply for RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026 should keep the following dates in mind.

content_sections.heading: RailTel Apprentice Vacancy 2026 - Post Details
content_sections.text: RailTel has announced apprentice engagement in two categories, with numbers described as tentative and subject to change without further notice. Apprentices may be engaged at RailTel's Corporate Office in New Delhi/Gurgaon, or across Northern Region locations (including Delhi, Jaipur, Lucknow, Gorakhpur, Bareilly, Amritsar, Rohtak, Chandigarh, Jodhpur, Ajmer, Bikaner, Agra, Jhansi, Aligarh, Roorkee, Moradabad, Delhi/NCR, Kanpur, Banda, Prayagraj, Varanasi and Mau), Eastern Region locations (Kolkata, Malda, Asansol, Patna, Dhanbad, Samastipur, Sonepur, Muzaffarpur, Gaya, Ranchi, Bhubaneswar, Guwahati and New Jalpaiguri), Southern Region locations (Secunderabad, Bangalore, Chennai and Vijayawada), and Western Region locations (Nagpur, Bhopal, Ahmedabad and Mumbai). Candidates may opt for any location of their convenience, though allotment depends on RailTel's presence there; if RailTel has no presence at the chosen location, a nearby location may be allotted instead.

content_sections.heading: RailTel Apprentice Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must satisfy the qualification, experience and age conditions listed below to be considered for RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026. Candidates who obtained their qualification through distance learning or part-time mode are not eligible to apply. Any engineering graduate or diploma holder who has undergone, or possesses, training or job/work experience of one year or more after attaining the qualification mentioned above is not eligible. Candidates who completed their graduation or diploma more than three years ago will also not be considered for this apprenticeship. Candidates who have already completed an apprenticeship, terminated one midway, or are currently pursuing an apprenticeship with another organization are not eligible either.

rows.qualification_required: Full-time regular 4-year Graduation in Engineering/Technology from an AICTE-approved college, with an aggregate of 60% marks, in Electronics & Telecommunication; or Telecommunication; or Computer Science & Engineering/Information Technology; or Electrical Engineering; or Electronics Engineering; or any combination of engineering branches where Electronics is one of the main branches (such as Electronics & Instrumentation) - OR passed Sections A and B of the Institution of Engineers (India) examinations in the above relevant branches - OR passed the Graduate Membership Examination of the Institution of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineers (India) in the above relevant branches.
Full-time regular 3-year Diploma in Engineering/Technology from an AICTE-approved college, with an aggregate of 60% marks, in the same branches listed above.

rows.age_limit: 18 to 27 years, as on the date of notification (28.07.2026)
Age relaxation as per Presidential/Governmental Directives - specific number of relaxation years not specified in the notification

content_sections.heading: RailTel Apprentice Salary (Stipend)
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a monthly consolidated stipend for the one-year apprenticeship period, shared between RailTel and the Government of India (DBT share), as shown below. No other benefit, facility, or allowance is payable apart from this consolidated stipend.

content_sections.heading: RailTel Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following process as described in the notification: A merit list will be prepared region/state/location-wise on receipt of online applications, with preference given to Government Institution pass-outs. Shortlisting will be done based on the merit list prepared using marks obtained in the required qualification (minimum eligibility), and/or through an interview as required. Only candidates found medically fit as per RailTel's norms will be considered for engagement. Merely meeting the eligibility criteria does not assure engagement. Candidature is provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates/testimonials at any stage; false or incorrect information can lead to cancellation of candidature or engagement.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Certificate showing CGPA or percentage, to be uploaded in the "Upload Certificate" column on the NATS portal. If only CGPA is mentioned on the certificate, candidates must also upload the CGPA-to-percentage conversion formula/certificate. The Undertaking (Annexure I, provided with the notification), duly filled and signed. The above documents must be uploaded together as a single PDF file of size less than 1 MB.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must apply online through the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) 2.0 portal - no other mode of application will be entertained under any circumstances. Visit the NATS 2.0 portal at https://nats.education.gov.in. Candidates not already registered on the NATS 2.0 portal must register themselves before applying for this position. Follow the application process as described in the NATS Apprentice student manual, available at the portal. Fill in the application form and upload the certificate showing CGPA or percentage, along with the CGPA-conversion certificate (if applicable) and the signed Undertaking, as a single PDF under 1 MB. Submit the application on or before the last date, 27.08.2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an apprenticeship engagement drive by RailTel Corporation of India Limited (RCIL), a Navratna PSU under the Ministry of Railways, for Graduate Engineer and Diploma Engineer Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961, notified on 28.07.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 40 posts in total - 32 Graduate Engineer Apprentice and 8 Diploma Engineer Apprentice posts (tentative, and computed from the numbers given in the notification).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of application is 27.08.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A full-time regular 4-year engineering degree (for Graduate Engineer Apprentice) or 3-year diploma (for Diploma Engineer Apprentice) from an AICTE-approved college, with 60% aggregate marks, in Electronics & Telecommunication, Telecommunication, Computer Science & Engineering/IT, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related combination branch.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 27 years of age as on the date of notification (28.07.2026), with age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per Presidential/Governmental Directives.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online only through the NATS 2.0 portal at nats.education.gov.in. Candidates who are not already registered on NATS 2.0 need to register first before applying.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a region/state/location-wise merit list prepared from online applications (with preference to Government Institution pass-outs), shortlisting on marks in the required qualification and/or an interview, and a medical fitness check.

faq.question: Q9. What is the stipend for RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Graduate Apprentices receive ₹14,000 per month and Diploma Apprentices receive ₹12,000 per month, as a consolidated stipend shared between RailTel and the Government of India.

faq.question: Q10. Where will selected RailTel apprentices be posted?
faq.answer: Postings can be at RailTel's Corporate Office (New Delhi/Gurgaon) or at Northern, Eastern, Southern or Western regional locations across India, on a pan-India basis, subject to RailTel's presence and availability at the chosen location.
